clauses.text: We have your message about the increase from CHF 2,050 to CHF 2,290 per month, effective 1 April, and your questions about the reference-rate component, the stairwell and lift work, and possible double-counting.

The available information does not establish the date you received the notice, so we cannot yet assess the objection deadline. The checklist lists the rent-increase notice and proof of receipt as missing.
Please send the rent-increase notice and any proof showing when it was delivered or received, and tell us the date you received it if you know it.

Please also provide the lease contract, current-rent evidence, any prior rent adjustment, the stated reasons and calculation, and the reference-rate basis; the checklist lists each of these as missing.

To assess the renovation component and your concern about possible double-counting, please provide the renovation-cost breakdown. The checklist lists it as missing. Old-lift inspection, repair and maintenance records could also help assess your concern about the lift work.
If available, please also send any correspondence with the landlord about the increase; the checklist lists this as missing but optional.
Once we have the notice and receipt information, the deadline and the calculation can be reviewed. The current information is not enough to assess the merits or likelihood of success.
